subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: (R)PER.VT.U.FUND.------WO.EXT.PRIN.
description: Chart on book p. 173 (SR(TRS)II-29). PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; WO-EXT-PRIN is the partner. From the subject: PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). From PRI-AF-TD: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From SPT-DYM: POST (postulation) and RIT-DYM (ritual dynamics). From RIT-DYM: V-SY (value system) and TR-DEF (trans-definition). From V-SY: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From TR-DEF: AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
